translations.english: Through the intercessions, of the holy archangel, Gabriel the announcer, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
translations.arabic: بشفاعات، رئيس الملائكة الطاهر، غبريال المبشر، يا رب أنعم علينا بمغفرة خطايانا.

translations.english: Through the prayers, of Zechariah the priest, and his wife Elizabeth, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
